title: Intake detector: items drifted from their commits
goal: intake's drift detector reports one triage story listing each doing item whose KB-Work work commit on origin/main is older than DRIFT_HOURS with no done, and each draft or todo item with touches whose own checks already pass on HEAD (run with the item's checks, a per-check timeout, only for items whose touches changed since their file did); the fingerprint is the sorted item ids

gates.question: How long may a doing item sit after its work commit landed before drift reports it (DRIFT_HOURS)?
gates.recommendation: 24: a sprint run lands and closes an item within a session; a day covers an interrupted one
